title: fix: use ContentType parser for response schema lookup
prompt: The response schema lookup was using a naive `split(';', 1)[0]` to extract the media type from Content-Type headers. This fails when there is whitespace before the semicolon. Switched to the existing `ContentType` parser which handles this correctly.
